eyebrow.zh: 增量重算 · 脏闭包 · 国产模型

headline.zh:
文件一改，
只重算变脏的几个节点
headline.en:
Edit one file,
re-derive only the stale nodes

sub.zh: 给已有的代码知识图谱接上 Bazel 式脏标记：只重算受影响闭包，而不是整库重扫。
sub.en: Bazel-style dirty-marking for your existing code knowledge-graph: re-derive only the affected closure, not the whole graph.

title.zh: 改一个文件，不必重扫整库
title.en: Edit a file, skip the full re-scan

body.zh: 靠内容哈希找出真正改动的源文件，只把它们派生的节点标脏。1200 个节点的图里，改一个叶子只标脏 3 个。
body.en: Content-hash diff finds only the files that really changed and marks just the nodes they derive. On a 1,200-node graph, editing one leaf dirties 3.

title.zh: 看清每个脏节点的来由
title.en: See why every node is stale

body.zh: 状态命令打印脏闭包大小；加 --why 还能逐节点说明——是源文件直接改了，还是沿依赖边传过来的。
body.en: Status prints the dirty-closure size; --why explains each node — a direct source change or propagated along an edge.

title.en: Re-summarize the closure with CN models

body.zh: 把脏闭包交给 DeepSeek / Qwen 重新摘要；端点不稳时自动回退到本地摘要，重算批次永不因网络中断。
body.en: Hand the dirty closure to DeepSeek / Qwen for re-summarization; falls back to a local summary on any endpoint error so a batch never dies on a flaky network.

title.zh: watch 实时标脏，改了就知道

body.zh: 文件一存，watch 立即重算脏闭包并打印；它自己写状态文件不会再触发循环。
body.en: On every save, watch recomputes the dirty closure and prints it; its own state writes never re-trigger the loop.

headline.zh: 把整库重扫，换成只重算脏的
headline.en: Swap the full re-scan for a dirty-only re-derive

sub.zh: 接入你已有的 graphify 或 code-review-graph 输出，立刻看到『重算 4 个节点而非 1200 个』。
sub.en: Point it at your existing graphify or code-review-graph output and see 're-derived 4 nodes instead of 1,200'.
